create_agent_jobs: create a FastAgent with a jobs agent that uses the live_hf server to run HF jobs
summarize_conversation: summarize the agent conversation history using ConversationSummary to extract tool call metrics
extract_job_id: extract the job ID from message history using extract_last with a regex pattern
inspect_job_status: inspect a Hugging Face job status using HfApi inspect_job with a job ID
save_conversation_history: save the agent message history to a JSON file using save_messages
